shortDescription: Adani Enterprises NSE:ADANIENT said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell up to a 5.54% stake in airport unit Adani Airport Holdings to investors, including Temasek, BlackRock, Premji Invest and Alpha Wave, to fund the business.
